# KAM INFO

KAM INFO is a Moroccan ecommerce brand for laptops and accessories.
Canonical website: https://kaminfo.shop/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/kam.info1/

## Main offer
- Product: KAM INFO Gaming Pack
- Price: 289 MAD
- Includes: Gaming RGB keyboard, Logitech G302 mouse, gaming mouse pad 30×70 cm
- Payment: cash on delivery / paiement à la livraison
- Delivery: available across Morocco
- Typical delivery window stated on the site: 24h to 48h depending on city and carrier availability
- Product availability: in stock

## Ordering
Customers choose a mouse-pad design, provide name and Moroccan phone number, then city and delivery address. The order is sent for processing and the customer is redirected to a confirmation page.

## Reviews
Public customer reviews are loaded from the site database and only approved reviews are displayed. New reviews are submitted for moderation before publication.

## FAQ topics
The site answers questions about cash on delivery, delivery times and coverage in Morocco, pack contents, product quality, returns/support, how to order, and suitability for gaming and daily use.
